elements.description: What the model can see, as chips with their token weight: remove (undoable), pin, and the total against the window.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the group's name

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Size of the context window in tokens (0: no meter, only the total)

properties.name: reserved
properties.description: Tokens already in the window besides these items – system prompt, tools, the conversation

properties.name: warnAt
properties.description: Share of the limit from which the tray warns (0–1)

properties.name: undoTimeout
properties.description: How long Undo stays after a removal, in ms (0: no undo)

properties.name: emptyText
properties.default: "Nothing in context yet – type @ to add files, people or sources"
properties.description: What the tray says with no items

properties.name: used
properties.description: Tokens in the window: the reserved part plus every item

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-items-change
events.description: `items` is about to change (`ContextTrayItemsChange`: `{ items, change: { type, item } }`, type "remove" | "restore" | "pin" | "unpin"). Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current items (controlled use)

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Puts the last removed item back (what Undo and ⌘Z do); false when there's nothing to undo

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the group's name (default "In context")

props.name: items
props.description: The chips. Controlled when given; otherwise the tray keeps its own, starting at `defaultItems`

props.name: defaultItems
props.description: The starting chips when `items` isn't given

props.name: onChange
props.description: Every remove, undo (restore), pin and unpin, with the items after it

changelog: `tc-context-tray` – what's in context as chips with token weights, a meter against the window with a reserved share, pin, remove with undo (⌘/Ctrl+Z), and a warning near the limit. Toolbar keyboard; `tc-items-change` (cancelable).

chat-composer (the Lit element and `trenchcoat/react`): opt-in `mentions` (a `tc-mention-picker` on the message) and `context` / `context-limit` (a `tc-context-tray` above it). Without them it renders as before.
